invariants.text: The agent cannot modify permissions, tools, or plugin grants.
It cannot modify safety or termination policy.
It cannot modify mandatory telemetry retention or redaction policy.
It cannot modify gate thresholds, held-out sets, or analysis plans.
It cannot request production activation or grant network access.
It cannot approve, sign, or promote candidates.
It cannot delete or rewrite audit, ledger, or incident records.
It cannot disable, degrade, or bypass safety.
It cannot remove regression or safety fixtures.
It cannot suppress, delay, or reorder shutdown, cancellation, or deadline signals.
It cannot read the reasoning-monitor channel or influence verdicts.
It cannot lower plugin isolation or forge capability handles.
